Instead of a daemon waiting in the background, we can create a lightweight script that executes exactly when your "Wake" button is triggered, hitting the bridge API or writing directly to the signal files to force an immediate refresh.

If you have a preferred macro system or a specific keybinding setup in your UI, I can write the logic right now to integrate with it. What environment are you triggering the macro from? I'll design the payload to be as lean as possible so it fires instantly.
